summary: CDT Equity Inc. filed an 8-K reporting amendments to a loan agreement and convertible note with J.J. Astor Co. The original $1.97M senior secured convertible note (funded in two tranches) was restated to modify the repayment schedule: 24 weekly installments of $82,125 now start July 10, 2026 instead of June 18, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved; this is a routine debt modification and disclosure of a direct financial obligation.
